Subject: Revenue readiness handoff and board forecast narrative - requests and timeline

Team —

We need to lock the bookings/ARR narrative for the board packet next week. This thread is the handoff and list of concrete asks from RevOps + Finance. Goal: have reconciled numbers + evidence uploaded by EOD Monday 8/16 so I can consolidate and run to Vivek for sign-off.

Action items (please reply inline with status):
- Stage hygiene: update opportunity stage to one of {commit, upside, at-risk, no-go} and set expected close date where missing. (owner: SDR/AE)
- Commit review: flag deals we want to carry in the commit corridor and add a one-line confidence note. (owner: AEs; finish by 8/16 5pm PT)
- Evidence: upload bookkeeping docs / LOIs / signed contract stubs to Drive and attach matching rows in the bookings-evidence-template.xlsx I attached.
- ARR math: if you are carrying any mid-year ACV adjustments (upsells/downsizes), add a comment in the sheet and include a reconciliation file.
- Risk callouts: list any deals > $200k that are borderline and add a short mitigation plan.

Attachments: bookings-evidence-template.xlsx (template for the evidence upload).

Timeline:
- 8/16 EOD PT: final inputs in drive + spreadsheet
- 8/17 morning: consolidated pack circulated to leadership for review
- 8/17 afternoon: 30-min sync (Finance + Sales Ops) to walk through any open items

Please keep thread tight — simple yes/no/ETA replies are fine. I will circulate consolidated narrative after I ingest your inputs.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks team — good progress. Two asks from leadership perspective: 
1) Please call out any deals > $200k that we are still carrying in the commit corridor and include a one-line "sign-off" from the AE (I want to see who is willing to take credit for the commit).
2) Prepare a one-slide summary of risk exposure (top 5 deals by $ at-risk) that I can include in the board appendix. Mark any external dependencies (procurement, 3rd-party approvals).

If anything looks like it could materially move ARR in the next 30 days, flag it in the spreadsheet with a red tag and comment the expected delta. Evelyn — happy to review the consolidated pack after you pull everything together.

Vivek
